description: The photovoltaic generation data from the Belgian power grid. The load data from the Portuguese power grid. is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Kai Tao. "The photovoltaic generation data used in this example is taken from an open-source dataset on the Belgian power grid. The load data comes from an open-source Portuguese dataset. The dataset spans two years. One year data was used for both validation and training. The validation set was selected from the dataset prior to training. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
